name: String Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a haunted dark violin with a smiling face on its upper bowl and a bow of green plasma
entry: It plays haunting melodies on moonlit nights. Plants nearby are said to grow towards the sound.
how: Use a Phantom Bow on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Energy Ball in this form.
